children: CareTrust REIT arranged an offering of 19.55 million common shares at $36 per share, an implied gross offering value of approximately $703.8 million before underwriting discounts and contractual adjustments. The offering included an initial 17 million shares and 2.55 million additional shares after the underwriters exercised their option. Bank of America and Morgan Stanley entered into forward sale agreements with CareTrust, and the company expects to receive cash upon physical settlement, which may occur through November 12, 2027.
